name: customer_objections
description: Timestamped objections, concerns, and blockers raised by prospects or customers in calls, interviews, demos, and feedback videos.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: A concise description of the objection.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Low, medium, or high severity based on whether the objection blocks progress.

fields.name: speaker
fields.description: The person or role raising the objection if identifiable.

fields.name: suggested_response
fields.description: A concise response or follow-up action implied by the evidence.
